description: Returns one design from the NightMarquee library: its build prompt for the chosen coding tool, its live demo link and whether a starter project is available. Pass a brand name to have the prompt use it. Use it after search_designs, once you know which design you want. Free designs need no account; paid designs need a connected account with a plan.

brand.description: A name for the site; it replaces the design's sample brand in the prompt. Up to 24 characters.

tool.description: The coding tool the build prompt is written for. The default is claude.

name: get_design
title: Get a design
